AMD is really great right now for price reasons. If you go their high end you are looking at more than Intel. The High end AMD is the TR4 Socketed Threadripper 2. It's a 32 core CPU and I think it's going to retail at or around 2000. That just for the CPU. The boards are at least 450 bucks.

AMD is better at streaming, video editing and daily driving/work computing. It's just the amount of cores.

Now as far as Ram goes, if you go AMD realize that the frequency you will operate at will depend on your CPU. Even if your board will support 3200 Mhz it will require and XMP profile (Overclock) to get it. Example. My AMD Ryzen system will only let me get to 2933 stable. I can hit 3200 but it locks up. The timing aren't my favorite but it's not horrible. The same ram on Intel will operate at 3200 and better timings. I haven't tweaked this board yet as it is pretty new. I am waiting on my new Ryzen to get here. When it gets here any testing I did on this current Ryzen will be worthless. Ryzen Memory timings and speed are CPU bound. Take a Ryzen 1600x and compare it to another Ryzen 1600x on the same board. The memory timings might work for one cpu but not the other because of the way they have the cores communicate using Infinity Fabric. I don't pretend to understand it, but I have never had as many issues getting ram setup than I have with this system. It was fun to me though.

My intel setup is an I5. 6600k at 4.6 ghz on water. If you go intel if you can find an 8086K CPU then get it. It's a limited run chip and the fastest at gaming. If you can't then the mid to high tier option is the Intel i7 8700k. That's the typical gamer CPU. You can always go to their 9 series if you have the cash, but I would go Threadripper if I was going to spend that kind of money.

GPU: Nvidia 1080 Ti 11 GB card. If you want to throw money at something then the new RTX 2080 Ti. I use a 1070 currently. I plan to upgrade to the Asus Strix 1080 Ti 11 gb in the next month or two as prices are dropping.

That is my two cents. Don't spend it all in one place.
